## GWAS preparation pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

Standardise GWAS summary statistics, lifted from hg19 to hg38, munged for LDSR with
[ldsc](https://github.com/bulik/ldsc) `munge_sumstats.py` (`--signed-sumstats Z,0`,
`--merge-alleles` HapMap3 SNPs).

LDSC citation: Bulik-Sullivan BK *et al.* (2015). LD Score regression distinguishes confounding
from polygenicity in genome-wide association studies. *Nature Genetics* 47, 291-295.

***

```{r set_up, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowplot)

# Set variables from params (paths are relative to workflow/)
gwas_list <- strsplit(params$gwas, ",")[[1]]
gwas_files <- strsplit(params$gwas_files, ",")[[1]]
gwas_md5 <- strsplit(params$gwas_md5, ",")[[1]]
unlifted_template <- params$unlifted
log_dir <- params$log_dir
bmark_dir <- params$bmark_dir
```

1. `extract_gwas_sumstats`: Decompress the downloaded GWAS and drop `##` header lines
2. `standardise_sumstats`: Standardise column names with python_convert
3. `add_z_score`: Add signed Z where the GWAS lacks it
4. `add_N`: Add N
5. `make_gwas_bed_hg19`: Make the hg19 bed file for liftOver
6. `liftover_gwas_to_hg38`: Lift SNPs from hg19 to hg38
7. `add_hg38_coords_to_gwas`: Replace hg19 with hg38 coordinates in the sumstats
8. `munge_sumstats`: Format sumstats for LDSR
9. `prep_gwas_report`: Summarise GWAS preparation

***

```{r functions, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Logs from older runs use different wording to the current scripts, so patterns
# match both
read_log <- function(rule, gwas) {
  f <- file.path(log_dir, paste0(rule, "_", gwas, ".log"))
  if (file.exists(f)) read_lines(f) else character(0)
}

grab <- function(lines, pattern) {
  hit <- str_match(lines, pattern)[, 2]
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
}

to_num <- function(x) as.numeric(str_remove_all(x, ","))

count_unlifted <- function(gwas) {
  f <- str_replace(unlifted_template, fixed("{gwas}"), gwas)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(!str_starts(read_lines(f), "#"))
}

munge <- map(set_names(gwas_list), ~ read_log("munge_sumstats", .x))
```

### SNP counts

***

```{r snp_counts, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
counts <- map_dfr(gwas_list, function(g) {
  std <- read_log("standardise_sumstats", g)
  z <- read_log("add_z_score", g)
  hg38 <- read_log("add_hg38_coords_to_gwas", g)
  tibble(
    GWAS = toupper(g),
    standardised = to_num(grab(std, "^Done\\. (\\d+) SNPs saved")),
    with_z = to_num(grab(z, "Wrote ([0-9,]+) rows")),
    lifted = to_num(grab(hg38, "(?:Lifted file processed|Lifted SNPs): (\\d+)")),
    unlifted = count_unlifted(g),
    hg38_rows = to_num(grab(hg38, "(?:Merged dataset|Merged SNPs): (\\d+)")),
    munge_read = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Read (\\d+) SNPs from --sumstats")),
    munged = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "\\((\\d+) with nonmissing beta\\)")))
})

counts |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Table 1. SNPs at each step",
             subtitle = "hg38 rows can exceed lifted SNPs where SNP IDs are duplicated (e.g. '.')") |>
  cols_label(standardised = "Standardised", with_z = "With Z", lifted = "Lifted to hg38",
             unlifted = "Failed liftOver", hg38_rows = "hg38 sumstats",
             munge_read = "Read by munge", munged = "After munge") |>
  fmt_integer(columns = -GWAS) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), heading.align = "center") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
```

***

### Munge QC

***

```{r munge_qc, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Each "Removed N SNPs ..." line; the N filter threshold differs per GWAS, so it is
# reported in its own table
removed <- map_dfr(gwas_list, function(g) {
  lines <- str_subset(munge[[g]], "^Removed \\d+ ")
  tibble(
    GWAS = toupper(g),
    n = as.numeric(str_match(lines, "^Removed (\\d+) ")[, 2]),
    filter = lines |>
      str_remove("^Removed \\d+ (SNPs|variants) ") |>
      str_remove(" \\(\\d+ SNPs remain\\)") |>
      str_remove("\\.$") |>
      str_replace("^with N < [0-9.]+$", "with N below threshold"))
})

removed |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = GWAS, values_from = n) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Table 2. SNPs removed by munge filters") |>
  cols_label(filter = "Filter") |>
  fmt_integer(columns = -filter) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), heading.align = "center") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))

map_dfr(gwas_list, function(g) {
  tibble(
    GWAS = toupper(g),
    merge_snps = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Read (\\d+) SNPs for allele merge")),
    n_threshold = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "with N < ([0-9.]+)")),
    median_z = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Median value of SIGNED_SUMSTATS was ([-0-9.e]+)")),
    mean_chi2 = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Mean chi\\^2 = ([0-9.]+)")),
    lambda_gc = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Lambda GC = ([0-9.]+)")),
    max_chi2 = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^Max chi\\^2 = ([0-9.]+)")),
    gws_snps = to_num(grab(munge[[g]], "^(\\d+) Genome-wide significant SNPs")))
}) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Table 3. Munge summary") |>
  cols_label(merge_snps = "SNPs in merge list", n_threshold = "N threshold",
             median_z = "Median Z", mean_chi2 = "Mean chi^2", lambda_gc = "Lambda GC",
             max_chi2 = "Max chi^2", gws_snps = "Genome-wide sig. SNPs") |>
  fmt_integer(columns = c(merge_snps, n_threshold, gws_snps)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), heading.align = "center") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
```

***

### Z scores

***

```{r z_scores, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
map_dfr(gwas_list, function(g) {
  z <- read_log("add_z_score", g)
  formula <- grab(z, "Z = (.+)$")
  if (is.na(formula) && any(str_detect(z, "keeping it"))) formula <- "Existing Z column"
  tibble(GWAS = toupper(g), Z = formula)
}) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Table 4. Source of Z") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), heading.align = "center") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
```

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Benchmark files: reports/benchmarks/09prep_gwas.<rule>[_<wildcards>].benchmark.txt
# Rule names contain '_', so files are matched against the known rules, and only
# current GWAS are kept (old runs drop out)
smk_rules <- c("extract_gwas_sumstats", "standardise_sumstats", "add_z_score", "add_N",
               "make_gwas_bed_hg19", "liftover_gwas_to_hg38", "add_hg38_coords_to_gwas",
               "munge_sumstats", "prep_gwas_report")
smk_rules <- smk_rules[order(-nchar(smk_rules))]
valid_wildcards <- c("", gwas_list)

files <- list.files(bmark_dir, pattern = "^09prep_gwas\\..*\\.benchmark\\.txt$",
                    full.names = TRUE)

benchmarks <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  stem <- str_remove(basename(f), "^09prep_gwas\\.") |> str_remove("\\.benchmark\\.txt$")
  rule <- smk_rules[stem == smk_rules | startsWith(stem, paste0(smk_rules, "_"))][1]
  if (is.na(rule)) return(NULL)
  wildcards <- str_remove(stem, paste0("^", rule, "_?"))
  if (!wildcards %in% valid_wildcards) return(NULL)
  df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

  tibble(
    file = f,
    rule = rule,
    runtime_sec = df$s,
    runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
    max_rss = df$max_rss
  )
})

# Summarise by rule
summary <- benchmarks %>%
  group_by(rule) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  arrange(rule)

# Table
summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 5. Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r, runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                 y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_runtime_min - ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min), 0),
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                                y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_ram_gb - ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb), 0),
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
